exposure: autologous blood transfusion during cesarean section
outcome: adverse reactions related to autologous blood recovery and transfusion
cohort: 294 patients with placenta previa who underwent cesarean section with autologous blood recovery between August 2016 and July 2018 at a single center
finding: Autologous blood transfusion during cesarean section in patients with placenta previa was safe and reduced the need for allogeneic blood transfusions.
